title: Implement GC executor with immutable audit log
description:
Implement GcExecutor::run(candidates: Vec<Cid>): for each candidate, call unpin(), then write an append-only audit record to SQLite: (cid, group, ingestion_time, gc_time, reason). Never delete audit records. Artifact: transit/src/retention/gc_executor.rs and transit/src/retention/audit_log.rs.

Acceptance:
- Audit record written after each successful unpin (not before)
- Audit log is append-only: no UPDATE or DELETE in the SQL schema
- gc_time is the actual time of unpin (not the scheduled time)
- Reason field records which policy rule (or 'no_matching_rule') caused GC
- Unit test: run GC on 10 articles, verify all 10 audit records written
